messages:
mina: Heads-up: we need to lock launch gates for the Optimize Toolkit pilot. Customers in pilot expect eval-triggered alerts + per-route quantization recommendations. Proposing minimal gating checklist:
1) batching + caching baseline tests
2) quant recommendation UI + API
3) eval alert wiring into Console (alerts + runbooks)
4) rollback & canary policy

rachel: +1 on checklist. Can we add a measurable SLO for token latency and a cost delta budget? pilots will want numbers.

sam: For batching baseline, we should define target p95 per-token latency and a unit-cost ceiling. Suggest p95 < 120ms (chat seq len 128) and unit-cost delta < 15% vs current hosted.

jordan: Agree. Also need to spell out what 'quant recs' means: automated suggestion only vs auto-apply. Ops should default to suggestion-only for pilot.

eli: Important: eval-triggered alerts must be configurable per-customer with eval suite id + threshold. Example config:
```
optimize:
  batching:
    max_batch_ms: 20
  quant:
    mode: suggest_only
    profiles: ["nf4", "int8"]
  eval_alerts:
    suite_id: "pilot-llm-regressions"
    threshold_pct: 5
```

mina: Good config example. For rollout: canary to 5% of traffic on Dedicated customers, feature flag for hosted. Must include automatic fallback to float model if quality regresses.

rachel: Launch criteria proposal:
- Pilot customers onboarded: >=3
- Eval alerting piped to Console with runbooks: yes
- Quant recs validated on held-out prompts: >=80% match with manual recommended profile
- Cost/latency within agreed budget: yes

sam: Customer ask: allow override per-route (embeddings vs chat) and annotation for why a quant rec was rejected. That helps eval.

jordan: Risk notes: auto-apply quant could break hallucination-sensitive prompts. Keep suggestion-only for 1.0.

ops-bot: Reminder: schedule infra smoke test: `./scripts/run_optimize_smoke.sh --canary` on 2045-06-20

mina: Action items:
- @sam: write the SLO + cost definition doc (due 3 workdays)
- @rachel: draft launch gates page + runbooks (due EOW)
- @eli: add eval_alert config to Console (PR)
- @jordan: confirm per-route override UX

rachel: Sounds good. I'll start the Launch Gating doc and ping legal for data controls for eval payloads.

mina: Thanks. We'll sync in Tuesday product sync with stakeholders. :thumbsup:
